label: Canonical IPTV packages: reprice iptv-1y / iptv-2y, add missing 3 / 6 / 12 / 24-month IPTV packages

execute.description: reprice legacy IPTV package iptv-1y (12 months) to 15000 IQD
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."package" SET "price" = 15000, "durationUnit" = 'YEAR', "updatedAt" = now() WHERE "slug" = 'iptv-1y' AND "serviceType" = 'IPTV' AND "durationMonths" = 12 AND ("price" <> 15000 OR "durationUnit" <> 'YEAR')

execute.description: reprice legacy IPTV package iptv-2y (24 months) to 25000 IQD
execute.sql: UPDATE "public"."package" SET "price" = 25000, "durationUnit" = 'YEAR', "updatedAt" = now() WHERE "slug" = 'iptv-2y' AND "serviceType" = 'IPTV' AND "durationMonths" = 24 AND ("price" <> 25000 OR "durationUnit" <> 'YEAR')

execute.description: insert IPTV packages for durations that have no active IPTV package
execute.sql:
INSERT INTO "public"."package" ("name", "slug", "serviceType", "price", "durationMonths", "durationUnit", "durationLabel", "description", "specifications", "isActive", "updatedAt")
SELECT v.name, v.slug, 'IPTV', v.price, v.months, v.unit, v.label, v.description, v.specifications, true, now()
FROM (VALUES
  ('IPTV 3 أشهر', 'iptv-3m', 6000, 3, 'MONTH', '3 أشهر', 'اشتراك IPTV لمدة 3 أشهر', 'اشتراك لمدة 3 أشهر'),
  ('IPTV 6 أشهر', 'iptv-6m', 10000, 6, 'MONTH', '6 أشهر', 'اشتراك IPTV لمدة 6 أشهر', 'اشتراك لمدة 6 أشهر'),
  ('IPTV 12 شهرًا', 'iptv-12m', 15000, 12, 'YEAR', 'سنة واحدة', 'اشتراك IPTV لمدة سنة واحدة', 'اشتراك لمدة 12 شهرًا'),
  ('IPTV 24 شهرًا', 'iptv-24m', 25000, 24, 'YEAR', 'سنتان', 'اشتراك IPTV لمدة سنتين', 'اشتراك لمدة 24 شهرًا')
) AS v(name, slug, price, months, unit, label, description, specifications)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "public"."package" p
  WHERE p."serviceType" = 'IPTV' AND p."durationMonths" = v.months AND p."isActive"
)
ON CONFLICT ("slug") DO NOTHING

postcheck.description: every canonical IPTV duration exists and the legacy rows carry the new prices
postcheck.sql:
SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT "durationMonths") FROM "public"."package" WHERE "serviceType" = 'IPTV' AND "durationMonths" IN (3, 6, 12, 24)) = 4
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."package" WHERE "serviceType" = 'IPTV' AND (("slug" = 'iptv-1y' AND "durationMonths" = 12 AND "price" <> 15000) OR ("slug" = 'iptv-2y' AND "durationMonths" = 24 AND "price" <> 25000))) AS "result"
